verseText: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the great fish, so the Son of Man will be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
meaning: Jesus compared what would happen to him with Jonah. Just as Jonah was inside the fish for three days and nights, Jesus would rise from the dead on the third day.

recall.question: What did Jesus mean when he said he would be in the “heart of the earth”?
choices: He would dig to the center of the earth
He would rise up to heaven

meaning.question: Jesus compared His time in the tomb what Bible story?

application.prompt: Jonah lived over 700 years before Jesus. Amazingly, God used the story of Jonah's three days in the fish to point ahead to what would happen with Jesus: he'd be buried in the grave, but then rise from the dead on the third day. Whenever you read the Old Testament, be on the lookout for how it points us to Jesus.
